ei.title: 6번: The Dark Side of Desert Solar Farms
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: It is now believed that deserts may be perfect places for harvesting solar power. If this is true, there would be no other place as ideal as the Sahara, the world's largest desert. Unfortunately, solar farms in the desert could have adverse environmental effects. For example, covering half the Sahara with solar farms would raise local temperatures by approximately 2.5 °C. This warming would not be limited to the desert — it would spread around the globe, eventually increasing the world's average temperature by 0.39 °C. This could speed up global warming by melting sea ice and exposing the dark water beneath it, which absorbs greater amounts of solar energy than sea ice does. Rising temperatures in the Sahara could also cause other problems by changing global precipitation patterns, including droughts in the Amazon and more frequent tropical cyclones.

questions.passage: It is now believed that deserts may be perfect places for harvesting solar power. If this is true, there would be no other place as ideal as the Sahara, the world's largest desert. Unfortunately, solar farms in the desert could have (A)[beneficial / adverse] environmental effects. For example, covering half the Sahara with solar farms would (B)[raise / lower] local temperatures by approximately 2.5 °C. This warming would not be limited to the desert — it would spread around the globe, eventually increasing the world's average temperature by 0.39 °C. This could speed up global warming by melting sea ice and exposing the dark water beneath it, which (C)[reflects / absorbs] greater amounts of solar energy than sea ice does. Rising temperatures in the Sahara could also cause other problems by changing global precipitation patterns, including droughts in the Amazon and more frequent tropical cyclones.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) adverse=부정적인 / beneficial=이로운 (B) raise=올리다 / lower=낮추다 (C) absorbs=흡수하다 / reflects=반사하다
det.analysis:
① beneficial—raise—absorbs: (A) 'Unfortunately' 뒤라 부정적 영향이므로 beneficial(이로운)이 아니라 adverse(부정적인)
② adverse—lower—reflects: (B) 사막을 태양광 패널로 덮으면 기온을 '올리므로(raise)' lower(낮추다)는 반대
③ adverse—raise—absorbs: 부정적 영향 + 기온을 올림 + 어두운 물이 에너지를 더 많이 흡수함 ←정답
④ beneficial—lower—reflects: 세 곳 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: Unfortunately → adverse(부정적) / 사막을 덮으면 기온 raise(상승) / 어두운 물은 에너지 absorbs(흡수)

questions.passage: It is now believed that deserts may be perfect places for harvesting solar power. If this is true, there would be no other place as (A)[unsuitable / ideal] as the Sahara, the world's largest desert. Unfortunately, solar farms in the desert could have adverse environmental effects. For example, covering half the Sahara with solar farms would raise local temperatures by approximately 2.5 °C. This warming would not be limited to the desert — it would (B)[spread / shrink] around the globe, eventually increasing the world's average temperature by 0.39 °C. This could speed up global warming by melting sea ice and exposing the dark water beneath it, which absorbs greater amounts of solar energy than sea ice does. Rising temperatures in the Sahara could also cause other problems by changing global precipitation patterns, including droughts in the Amazon and more (C)[rare / frequent] tropical cyclones.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) ideal=이상적인 / unsuitable=부적합한 (B) spread=퍼지다 / shrink=줄어들다 (C) frequent=잦은 / rare=드문
det.analysis:
① ideal—spread—frequent: 사하라가 태양광에 가장 이상적임 + 온난화가 지구로 퍼짐 + 더 잦은 열대성 저기압 ←정답
② unsuitable—spread—rare: (A) 태양광에 완벽한 곳이므로 unsuitable(부적합한)이 아니라 ideal(이상적인)
③ ideal—shrink—rare: (B) 온난화가 사막에 국한되지 않고 지구로 '퍼지므로(spread)' shrink(줄어들다)는 반대
④ unsuitable—shrink—frequent: (A)(B) 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 사하라 = ideal(이상적) / 온난화 spread(확산) / 더 frequent(잦은) 저기압

questions.passage: It is now believed that deserts may be perfect places for (A)[wasting / harvesting] solar power. If this is true, there would be no other place as ideal as the Sahara, the world's largest desert. Unfortunately, solar farms in the desert could have adverse environmental effects. For example, covering half the Sahara with solar farms would raise local temperatures by approximately 2.5 °C. This warming would not be limited to the desert — it would spread around the globe, eventually (B)[increasing / reducing] the world's average temperature by 0.39 °C. This could speed up global warming by (C)[freezing / melting] sea ice and exposing the dark water beneath it, which absorbs greater amounts of solar energy than sea ice does. Rising temperatures in the Sahara could also cause other problems by changing global precipitation patterns, including droughts in the Amazon and more frequent tropical cyclones.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) harvesting=수확하는 / wasting=낭비하는 (B) increasing=증가시키는 / reducing=감소시키는 (C) melting=녹이는 / freezing=얼리는
det.analysis:
① wasting—increasing—freezing: (A) 사막은 태양광을 '수확(harvesting)'하기 좋은 곳이지 낭비하는 곳이 아님
② harvesting—reducing—melting: (B) 지구 평균 기온을 '증가(increasing)'시키므로 reducing(감소)은 반대
③ wasting—reducing—freezing: (A)(B)(C) 모두 문맥과 반대
④ harvesting—increasing—melting: 태양광 수확 + 평균 기온 증가 + 해빙을 녹임 ←정답
det.tip: 태양광 harvesting(수확) / 평균 기온 increasing(증가) / 해빙 melting(녹임)

questions.passage: It is now believed that deserts may be perfect places for ①<u>harvesting</u> solar power. If this is true, there would be no other place as ideal as the Sahara, the world's largest desert. Unfortunately, solar farms in the desert could have ②<u>adverse</u> environmental effects. For example, covering half the Sahara with solar farms would ③<u>lower</u> local temperatures by approximately 2.5 °C. This warming would not be limited to the desert — it would ④<u>spread</u> around the globe, eventually increasing the world's average temperature by 0.39 °C. This could speed up global warming by melting sea ice and exposing the dark water beneath it, which absorbs greater amounts of solar energy than sea ice does. Rising temperatures in the Sahara could also cause other problems by changing global precipitation patterns, including droughts in the Amazon and more frequent tropical cyclones.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① harvesting=수확하는 ② adverse=부정적인 ③ raise→lower (부적절) ④ spread=퍼지다
det.analysis:
① harvesting: 사막은 태양광을 수확하기 좋은 곳 — 적절
② adverse: 사막의 태양광 발전은 부정적 환경 영향을 줄 수 있음 — 적절
③ lower: 사하라 절반을 덮으면 국지 기온을 '낮춘다(lower)'? 태양광 패널이 열을 가둬 기온을 '올리므로(raise)' 부적절 ←정답
④ spread: 온난화가 지구로 퍼짐 — 적절
det.tip: 패널이 열을 가둬 기온 raise(상승). lower(낮춤)는 정반대

questions.passage: It is now believed that deserts may be perfect places for harvesting solar power. If this is true, there would be no other place as ①<u>ideal</u> as the Sahara, the world's largest desert. Unfortunately, solar farms in the desert could have adverse environmental effects. For example, covering half the Sahara with solar farms would raise local temperatures by approximately 2.5 °C. This warming would not be limited to the desert — it would ②<u>spread</u> around the globe, eventually increasing the world's average temperature by 0.39 °C. This could speed up global warming by ③<u>melting</u> sea ice and exposing the dark water beneath it, which absorbs greater amounts of solar energy than sea ice does. Rising temperatures in the Sahara could also cause other problems by changing global precipitation patterns, including droughts in the Amazon and more ④<u>rare</u> tropical cyclones.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① ideal=이상적인 ② spread=퍼지다 ③ melting=녹이는 ④ frequent→rare (부적절)
det.analysis:
① ideal: 사하라만큼 이상적인 곳이 없음 — 적절
② spread: 온난화가 지구로 퍼짐 — 적절
③ melting: 해빙을 녹여 지구온난화를 가속 — 적절
④ rare: 기온 상승이 '더 드문(rare)' 열대성 저기압을 유발? 문제를 '더' 일으키는 흐름이므로 '더 잦은(frequent)'이 맞아 부적절 ←정답
det.tip: 기온 상승 → 더 frequent(잦은) 저기압. rare(드문)는 반대

questions.passage: It is now believed that deserts may be ①<u>perfect</u> places for harvesting solar power. If this is true, there would be no other place as ideal as the Sahara, the world's largest desert. Unfortunately, solar farms in the desert could have adverse environmental effects. For example, covering half the Sahara with solar farms would raise local temperatures by approximately 2.5 °C. This warming would not be limited to the desert — it would spread around the globe, eventually ②<u>increasing</u> the world's average temperature by 0.39 °C. This could speed up global warming by melting sea ice and exposing the dark water beneath it, which ③<u>reflects</u> greater amounts of solar energy than sea ice does. Rising temperatures in the Sahara could also cause other problems by ④<u>changing</u> global precipitation patterns, including droughts in the Amazon and more frequent tropical cyclones.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① perfect=완벽한 ② increasing=증가시키는 ③ absorbs→reflects (부적절) ④ changing=바꾸는
det.analysis:
① perfect: 사막은 태양광 발전에 완벽한 곳 — 적절
② increasing: 지구 평균 기온을 증가시킴 — 적절
③ reflects: 어두운 물이 해빙보다 태양 에너지를 더 많이 '반사(reflects)'한다? 어두운 물은 에너지를 더 '흡수(absorbs)'해서 온난화를 가속하므로 부적절 ←정답
④ changing: 강수 패턴을 바꿔 문제를 일으킴 — 적절
det.tip: 어두운 물은 에너지를 absorbs(흡수). reflects(반사)는 정반대라 온난화 논리와 모순

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: blocking=차단하는 / reducing=줄이는 / hiding=숨기는 / harvesting=수확하는
det.analysis:

det.tip: perfect places for __________ solar power → 수확하는(harvesting)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: disappear=사라지다 / weaken=약해지다 / spread=퍼지다 / reverse=되돌리다
det.analysis:
① disappear: 사라지다 — '사막에 국한되지 않는다'는 흐름과 반대
② weaken: 약해지다 — 뒤에 세계 평균 기온 상승이 이어지므로 부적절
③ spread: 온난화가 사막에 국한되지 않고 지구 전역으로 '퍼짐' ←정답
④ reverse: 되돌리다 — 문맥 무관
det.tip: would not be limited to the desert — it would __________ around the globe → 퍼지다(spread)

questions.passage: It is now believed that deserts may be perfect places for harvesting solar power. If this is true, there would be no other place as ideal as the Sahara, the world's largest desert. This warming would not be limited to the desert — it would spread around the globe, __________ increasing the world's average temperature by 0.39 °C. Rising temperatures in the Sahara could also cause other problems by changing global precipitation patterns, including droughts in the Amazon and more frequent tropical cyclones.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: eventually=결국 / rarely=좀처럼 ~않는 / immediately=즉시 / suddenly=갑자기
det.analysis:
① eventually: 온난화가 지구로 퍼져 '결국' 세계 평균 기온을 높이는 점진적 흐름 ←정답
② rarely: 좀처럼 ~않는 — 기온이 실제로 오르므로 반대
③ immediately: 즉시 — 사막→지구로 퍼진 뒤 일어나는 과정이라 부적절
④ suddenly: 갑자기 — 점진적 확산 흐름과 어울리지 않음
det.tip: spread around the globe, __________ increasing the temperature → 결국(eventually)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 adverse와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: adverse=부정적인, 해로운 / harmful=해로운 / helpful=도움이 되는 / normal=정상적인 / common=흔한
det.analysis:
① harmful: 해로운 — adverse(부정적인, 해로운)의 동의어 ←정답
② helpful: 도움이 되는 — adverse와 반대
③ normal: 정상적인 — 의미 다름
④ common: 흔한 — 의미 다름
det.tip: adverse environmental effects(부정적 영향) = harmful(해로운)

det.korean: approximately=대략 / exactly=정확히 / roughly=대략 / barely=거의 ~않는 / rarely=좀처럼 ~않는
det.analysis:

questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 power의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: power: (A) 전력, 동력 (B) 권력, 세력
det.analysis:
① (A) 전력, 동력 (B) 권력, 세력: 태양광 패널이 햇빛을 바꿔 만드는 것은 '전력', 혁명 후 지도자가 나라에 대해 가진 것은 '권력' ←정답
② (A) 권력, 세력 (B) 전력, 동력: (A) 집과 공장을 돌리는 것은 '전력'이라 부적절
③ (A) 전력, 동력 (B) 능력, 재능: (B) 나라 전체를 지배하는 것은 '권력'이지 재능이 아님
④ (A) 힘, 체력 (B) 권력, 세력: (A) 신체적 힘이 아니라 '전력'
det.tip: power의 다의어: 전력·동력(electricity) vs 권력·세력(control over people)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a long period of time when there is little or no rain, causing a shortage of water"

det.korean: flood=홍수 / harvest=수확 / storm=폭풍 / drought=가뭄(비가 거의 오지 않아 물이 부족한 오랜 기간)
det.analysis:
① flood: 홍수 — 물이 넘치는 것이라 정반대
② harvest: 수확 — 작물을 거두는 것으로 의미 다름
③ storm: 폭풍 — 강한 비·바람을 동반하는 것과 관련되어 부적절
④ drought: 가뭄 — 비가 거의 오지 않아 물이 부족한 오랜 기간 ←정답
det.tip: little or no rain + shortage of water = 가뭄(drought)

questions.passage: This warming would not be limited to the desert — it would spread around the globe, eventually increasing the world's average temperature by 0.39 °C. This could speed up global warming by melting sea ice and __________ (expose) the dark water beneath it, which absorbs greater amounts of solar energy than sea ice does.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: expose(동사: 드러내다) → exposing. 'by + 동명사'가 and로 병렬 연결(by melting ... and exposing ...)
det.analysis: 동사 expose를 동명사 exposing으로 바꿔요. 'by melting sea ice and __________ the dark water'에서 전치사 by 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 하고, 앞의 melting과 and로 나란히 연결되는 자리라 같은 형태인 exposing이 맞아요. 동사원형 expose는 올 수 없어요.
det.tip: by + 동명사(melting) and 동명사(exposing) 병렬. expose → exposing

questions.passage: It is now __________ (believe) that deserts may be perfect places for harvesting solar power. If this is true, there would be no other place as ideal as the Sahara, the world's largest desert.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: believe(동사: 믿다) → believed. 'It is believed that ~'는 '~라고 믿어진다'는 수동태(be + 과거분사)
det.analysis: 동사 believe를 과거분사 believed로 바꿔요. 'It is now __________ that ~'는 'It is believed that ~(~라고 여겨진다)'라는 수동태 구문이에요. 'be동사(is) + 과거분사' 형태가 필요하므로 동사원형 believe가 아니라 과거분사 believed가 맞아요.
det.tip: It is + 과거분사 + that ~ = ~라고 여겨진다(수동태). believe → believed

questions.passage: It is now believed that deserts may be perfect places for harvesting solar power. If this is true, there would be no other place as ideal as the Sahara, the world's largest desert. Unfortunately, solar farms in the desert could have adverse environmental effects. For example, covering half the Sahara with solar farms would raise local temperatures by approximately 2.5 °C. This warming would not be __________ the desert — it would spread around the globe, eventually increasing the world's average temperature by 0.39 °C. This could speed up global warming by melting sea ice and exposing the dark water beneath it, which absorbs greater amounts of solar energy than sea ice does. Rising temperatures in the Sahara could also cause other problems by changing global precipitation patterns, including droughts in the Amazon and more frequent tropical cyclones.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: caused by=~에 의해 야기된 / limited to=~에 국한된 / famous for=~로 유명한 / exposed to=~에 노출된
det.analysis:
① caused by: ~에 의해 야기된 — 뒤에 '지구로 퍼진다'가 이어지므로 부적절
② limited to: 이 온난화는 사막에 '국한되지' 않고 지구 전역으로 퍼짐 ←정답
③ famous for: ~로 유명한 — 문맥 무관
④ exposed to: ~에 노출된 — 문맥 무관
det.tip: This warming would not be __________ the desert — it would spread → ~에 국한된(limited to)

questions.passage: It is now believed that deserts may be perfect places for harvesting solar power. If this is true, there would be no other place as ideal as the Sahara, the world's largest desert. Unfortunately, solar farms in the desert could have adverse environmental effects. For example, covering half the Sahara with solar farms would raise local temperatures by approximately 2.5 °C. This warming would not be limited to the desert — it would spread around the globe, eventually increasing the world's average temperature by 0.39 °C. This could speed up global warming by melting sea ice and exposing the dark water beneath it, which absorbs greater amounts of solar energy than sea ice does. Rising temperatures in the Sahara could also cause other problems by __________, including droughts in the Amazon and more frequent tropical cyclones.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: cooling the ocean surface=해수면을 식힘 / changing global precipitation patterns=전 지구 강수 패턴을 바꿈 / reducing solar energy output=태양 에너지 출력을 줄임 / protecting tropical forests=열대림을 보호함
det.analysis:
빈칸 뒤에 '아마존의 가뭄과 더 잦은 열대성 저기압'이라는 예가 나와요. 이는 비가 내리는 방식이 달라졌다는 뜻이에요.
① cooling the ocean surface(해수면을 식힘): 온난화 맥락과 반대
② changing global precipitation patterns(전 지구 강수 패턴을 바꿈): 가뭄·저기압은 강수 패턴 변화의 결과이므로 딱 맞음 ←정답
③ reducing solar energy output(태양 에너지 출력을 줄임): 가뭄·저기압과 무관
④ protecting tropical forests(열대림을 보호함): 아마존 가뭄과 오히려 반대
det.tip: 가뭄 + 열대성 저기압 → 강수 패턴 변화(changing global precipitation patterns)
